documents.title: Clarification sought from Advance Agrolife Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Advance Agrolife Limited reported its highest ever quarterly performance for Q1 FY2027, with revenue reaching 3,304.0 million INR and PAT increasing by 152% year-on-year. Management highlighted ongoing backward integration efforts, capacity expansions such as the 4x scale-up in 2,4-D and upcoming units (Unit-4 and Unit-5), and a strategic goal to increase export revenue share to 20% by FY29. The company also noted benefits from structural geographical advantages and government anti-dumping duties on Pretilachlor. Advance Agrolife reported financial and operational results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management detailed strategic backward integration initiatives, capacity expansions in technical manufacturing such as 2,4-D and Pretilachlor, and plans for new facilities including Unit-4 and Unit-5.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the company is well-positioned to respond effectively to rising market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our focus on maintaining adequate inventory, supported by the working capital strengthened through IPO proceeds, enabled us to ensure uninterrupted supplies to our customers and respond effectively to rising market demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Total income for Q3 FY26 increased by 18 percent year-on-year due to increased demand and new customer additions.
demand_outlook.quote: • AAL’s Q3 FY26 Income at ₹ 1338 million increased by 18% Y-o-Y on the back of increased demand and addition of new customers.
